<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; fill: #1e293b; }
    .subtitle { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; fill: #334155; }
    .formula { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; fill: #2563eb; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; fill: #1e293b; font-weight: bold; }
    .dim { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #475569; font-weight: bold; }
    
    .sq-a { fill: #fca5a5; fill-opacity: 0.7; stroke: #ef4444; stroke-width: 2; }
    .sq-b { fill: #93c5fd; fill-opacity: 0.7; stroke: #3b82f6; stroke-width: 2; }
    .sq-c { fill: #86efac; fill-opacity: 0.7; stroke: #22c55e; stroke-width: 2; }
    .triangle { fill: #f1f5f9; stroke: #64748b; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    
    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; }
      50% { opacity: 1; }
    }
    
    .pulsing-c {
      animation: pulseGlow 3s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="400" y="45" text-anchor="middle" class="title">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>
  <text x="400" y="75" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle">a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- Definitions / Side Panel -->
  <rect x="470" y="110" width="300" height="350" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="495" y="150" class="label" fill="#0f172a">Right-Angled Triangle:</text>
  <text x="495" y="180" class="dim">• Longest side = Hypotenuse (c)</text>
  <text x="495" y="210" class="dim">• Other two sides = a and b</text>
  
  <text x="495" y="270" class="label" fill="#0f172a">Area Relationship:</text>
  <rect x="495" y="290" width="20" height="20" class="sq-a"/>
  <text x="525" y="306" class="dim">Area a² (Red)</text>
  
  <rect x="495" y="325" width="20" height="20" class="sq-b"/>
  <text x="525" y="341" class="dim">Area b² (Blue)</text>
  
  <rect x="495" y="360" width="20" height="20" class="sq-c"/>
  <text x="525" y="376" class="dim">Area c² (Green)</text>

  <text x="495" y="425" class="formula">a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- Geometric Diagram Area (Shifted slightly up to fit completely within y=0..500) -->
  <!-- Triangle scaled to size 120: A=(150, 330), B=(150, 210), C=(270, 330) -->

  <!-- Square on side b (left, 120x120) -->
  <rect x="30" y="210" width="120" height="120" class="sq-b">
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0.7;0.9;0.7" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
  <text x="90" y="275" text-anchor="middle" class="label">b²</text>

  <!-- Square on side a (bottom, 120x120) -->
  <rect x="150" y="330" width="120" height="120" class="sq-a">
    <animate attributeName="fill-opacity" values="0.7;0.9;0.7" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
  <text x="210" y="395" text-anchor="middle" class="label">a²</text>

  <!-- Square on hypotenuse c (rotated) -->
  <!-- B=(150, 210), C=(270, 330). Hypotenuse vector (120, 120). Outward perpendicular (120, -120). -->
  <!-- Points: (150, 210) [B], (270, 330) [C], (390, 210), (270, 90) -->
  <polygon points="150,210 270,330 390,210 270,90" class="sq-c pulsing-c"/>
  <text x="270" y="215" text-anchor="middle" class="label">c²</text>

  <!-- The Triangle itself -->
  <polygon points="150,210 150,330 270,330" class="triangle"/>

  <!-- Right angle marker -->
  <polyline points="150,310 170,310 170,330" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Labels for triangle sides -->
  <text x="135" y="275" text-anchor="end" class="label">b</text>
  <text x="210" y="355" text-anchor="middle" class="label">a</text>
  <text x="230" y="250" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#16a34a">Hypotenuse (c)</text>

  <!-- Animated indicator of energy/sum -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="90" cy="270" r="4" fill="#ef4444">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="90; 210; 270" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="270; 390; 210" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="210" cy="390" r="4" fill="#3b82f6">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="210; 270" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.2s"/>
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="390; 210" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.2s"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.2s"/>
    </circle>
  </g>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    }
    
    .title-text {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      fill: #1e293b;
    }
    
    .label-header {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    
    .label-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      fill: #475569;
      font-weight: 400;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" rx="12"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="45" text-anchor="middle" class="title-text">Parts of a Circle</text>

  <!-- ==================== CIRCLE & GEOMETRY ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(360, 260)">
    
    <!-- Circumference Animation / Highlight -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="160" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="1005" stroke-dashoffset="0">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" values="1005;0;1005" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    
    <!-- Main Circle Fill & Outline -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="160" fill="#e0f2fe" fill-opacity="0.4" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="4"/>

    <!-- Diameter Line (Passes through centre) -->
    <line x1="-160" y1="0" x2="160" y2="0" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;1;0.2" dur="8s" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </line>

    <!-- Radius Line (Centre to right edge) -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="160" y2="0" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.2;1" dur="8s" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </line>

    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#1e293b"/>
    <!-- Centre Point Pulse -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="3">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="6;20;6" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LABELS & ANNOTATIONS ==================== -->

  <!-- 1. CENTRE -->
  <g transform="translate(45, 120)">
    <line x1="165" y1="140" x2="255" y2="140" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
    <circle cx="165" cy="140" r="4" fill="#f59e0b"/>
    <text x="0" y="0" class="label-header" fill="#d97706">Centre</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="label-desc">Fixed point in the</text>
    <text x="0" y="40" class="label-desc">middle of the circle.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 2. RADIUS -->
  <g transform="translate(45, 270)">
    <path d="M 125, -10 L 165, -10" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
    <text x="0" y="0" class="label-header" fill="#059669">Radius</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="label-desc">Distance from the</text>
    <text x="0" y="40" class="label-desc">centre to the edge.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 3. DIAMETER -->
  <g transform="translate(580, 120)">
    <path d="M -60, 140 L -140, 140" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
    <text x="0" y="0" class="label-header" fill="#dc2626">Diameter</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="label-desc">Goes across through</text>
    <text x="0" y="40" class="label-desc">the centre (2 × radius).</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 4. CIRCUMFERENCE -->
  <g transform="translate(580, 310)">
    <path d="M -90, 10 L -40, 10" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
    <text x="0" y="0" class="label-header" fill="#2563eb">Circumference</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="label-desc">The total distance</text>
    <text x="0" y="40" class="label-desc">all the way around.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Interactive/Dynamic Legend Box at Bottom -->
  <rect x="180" y="440" width="440" height="40" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="205" cy="460" r="6" fill="#3b82f6">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.4;1;0.4" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <text x="225" y="465" font-size="14" fill="#334155" font-weight="600">Tip: Diameter is always double the radius (d = 2r)</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Series Circuit GCSE Physics</title>
  
  <style>
    .sans { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }
    .title-text { font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; }
    .label-text { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; fill: #334155; }
    .body-text { font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; }
    
    /* Electron / Current flow animation */
    .electron {
      fill: #ef4444;
      animation: flowAlongCircuit 3.5s linear infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.4)); }
      50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.9)); }
    }
    
    .glowing-lamp {
      animation: pulseGlow 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" rx="12" />

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="40" text-anchor="middle" class="sans title-text">Series Circuit: Current & Voltage</text>

  <!-- Explanation card top right -->
  <rect x="470" y="70" width="300" height="150" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="490" y="100" class="sans label-text" fill="#0f172a">Key Rules (GCSE):</text>
  <text x="490" y="130" class="sans body-text">1. Only ONE single loop.</text>
  <text x="490" y="155" class="sans body-text">2. Current ($I$) is the same everywhere.</text>
  <text x="490" y="180" class="sans body-text">3. Voltage ($V$) is shared across components.</text>

  <!-- Circuit Board / Area (Left side) -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 60)">
    <!-- Circuit Wires (Rectangle loop) -->
    <rect x="50" y="40" width="350" height="320" rx="10" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round" />

    <!-- Cell (Power Supply) at bottom -->
    <g transform="translate(175, 360)">
      <line x1="-30" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="6" />
      <!-- Long positive bar -->
      <line x1="-20" y1="-15" x2="-20" y2="15" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="6" />
      <text x="-25" y="-22" class="sans label-text" fill="#2563eb">+</text>
      <!-- Short negative bar -->
      <line x1="20" y1="-8" x2="20" y2="8" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="6" />
      <text x="15" y="-18" class="sans label-text" fill="#2563eb">-</text>
      
      <!-- Label for Cell -->
      <text x="0" y="38" text-anchor="middle" class="sans label-text">Cell ($V_{total}$)</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Component 1: Lamp 1 (Top wire) -->
    <g transform="translate(150, 40)" class="glowing-lamp">
      <rect x="-35" y="-22" width="70" height="44" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="3" rx="6" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2.5" />
      <line x1="-11" y1="-11" x2="11" y2="11" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2" />
      <line x1="11" y1="-11" x2="-11" y2="11" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2" />
    </g>
    <text x="150" y="5" text-anchor="middle" class="sans label-text">Lamp 1 ($V_1$)</text>

    <!-- Component 2: Lamp 2 (Top wire, right side) -->
    <g transform="translate(300, 40)" class="glowing-lamp">
      <rect x="-35" y="-22" width="70" height="44" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="3" rx="6" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2.5" />
      <line x1="-11" y1="-11" x2="11" y2="11" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2" />
      <line x1="11" y1="-11" x2="-11" y2="11" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2" />
    </g>
    <text x="300" y="5" text-anchor="middle" class="sans label-text">Lamp 2 ($V_2$)</text>

    <!-- Ammeter (Left vertical wire) -->
    <g transform="translate(50, 200)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="3" />
      <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" class="sans label-text" fill="#059669" font-size="18">A</text>
    </g>
    <text x="50" y="245" text-anchor="middle" class="sans body-text">Ammeter</text>

    <!-- ANIMATED ELECTRONS / CURRENT FLOW -->
    <!-- The circuit path perimeter is: 
         Start top-left (50,40) -> right to (400,40) [length 350]
         -> down to (400,360) [length 320]
         -> left to (50,360) [length 350]
         -> up to (50,40) [length 320]
         Total Perimeter = 1340px 
    -->
    <path id="circuit-path" d="M 50 40 H 400 V 360 H 50 V 40" fill="none" />
    
    <!-- We generate multiple electron dots along the path using animateMotion -->
    <circle r="6" class="electron"><animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#circuit-path" /></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle r="6" class="electron"><animateMotion dur="4s" begin="-1.0s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#circuit-path" /></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle r="6" class="electron"><animateMotion dur="4s" begin="-2.0s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#circuit-path" /></animateMotion></circle>
    <circle r="6" class="electron"><animateMotion dur="4s" begin="-3.0s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#circuit-path" /></animateMotion></circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom Interactive Callout / Summary box -->
  <rect x="470" y="240" width="300" height="210" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="490" y="275" class="sans label-text" fill="#1e293b">Formula Summary:</text>
  
  <rect x="490" y="295" width="260" height="45" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="510" y="323" class="sans body-text" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">Current: $I_1 = I_2 = I_3$</text>

  <rect x="490" y="350" width="260" height="45" rx="6" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="510" y="378" class="sans body-text" font-weight="bold" fill="#ea580c">Voltage: $V_{total} = V_1 + V_2$</text>

  <!-- Legend for current dots -->
  <circle cx="505" cy="415" r="5" fill="#ef4444" />
  <text x="520" y="420" class="sans body-text" font-size="12">Flow of conventional current / electrons</text>

</svg>

  <title>Photosynthesis Concept Diagram</title>

  <!-- Definitions for gradients and markers -->
  <defs>

      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f0f7f4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e2f0d9"/>

      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff2b2" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffd700" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffaa00" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Leaf Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="leafGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#73c03a"/>

    <rect x="-90" y="-20" width="160" height="40" rx="20" fill="#ebf8ff" stroke="#3182ce" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="-10" y="5" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2b6cb0" text-anchor="middle">Water (H₂O)</text>

  <path d="M 190 390 Q 260 380 320 320" fill="none" stroke="#3182ce" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>

  <!-- ================= OUTPUTS (Right Side) ================= -->

  <g transform="translate(700, 210)">
    <rect x="-70" y="-20" width="160" height="40" rx="20" fill="#fffaf0" stroke="#dd6b20" stroke-width="2"/>

  </g>
  <path d="M 610 210 Q 550 210 470 230" fill="none" stroke="#dd6b20" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>

  <!-- Oxygen Output -->

    <rect x="-70" y="-20" width="160" height="40" rx="20" fill="#f0fff4" stroke="#38a169" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="10" y="5" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f855a" text-anchor="middle">Oxygen (O₂)</text>
    <!-- Animated oxygen bubble/particle emerging -->

      <animate attributeName="cy" values="0;-30" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

  <path d="M 610 330 Q 530 310 440 270" fill="none" stroke="#38a169" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter - GCSE Chemistry</title>

  <style>
    .sans { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }
    .title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .desc { font-size: 15px; fill: #334155; text-anchor: middle; }
    .subdesc { font-size: 13px; fill: #64748b; text-anchor: middle; }
    
    /* Solid particle vibration */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      20% { transform: translate(2px, -1px); }
      40% { transform: translate(-1px, 2px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-2px, -1px); }
      80% { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    .p-solid {
      animation: vibrate 0.3s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    /* Liquid particle flow paths */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(12px, -8px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-8px, 10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-10px, 10px); }
      66% { transform: translate(14px, 4px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(8px, 12px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-12px, -6px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .p-liq-1 { animation: flow1 2.5s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .p-liq-2 { animation: flow2 2.2s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .p-liq-3 { animation: flow3 2.8s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas rapid movement */
    @keyframes gas-move-1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-55px, -35px); }
      50% { transform: translate(40px, -60px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-30px, 45px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(65px, 40px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-50px, 50px); }
      75% { transform: translate(20px, -55px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-40px, 60px); }
      50% { transform: translate(55px, -20px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-65px, -40px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes gas-move-4 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(45px, -50px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-30px, -50px); }
      75% { transform: translate(50px, 45px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .p-gas-1 { animation: gas-move-1 1.4s infinite linear; }
    .p-gas-2 { animation: gas-move-2 1.1s infinite linear; }
    .p-gas-3 { animation: gas-move-3 1.3s infinite linear; }
    .p-gas-4 { animation: gas-move-4 1.2s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" />

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="40" class="sans title">States of Matter</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 70)">
    <!-- Container Box -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="210" height="260" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3" />
    
    <!-- Label & Description -->
    <text x="105" y="300" class="sans label">Solid</text>
    <text x="105" y="323" class="sans desc">Close together</text>
    <text x="105" y="343" class="sans desc">Vibrate in place</text>
    <text x="105" y="366" class="sans subdesc">(Fixed regular pattern)</text>

    <!-- Particles (Regular Grid) -->
    <g fill="#3b82f6" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle cx="45" cy="65" r="14" class="p-solid" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="65" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
      <circle cx="125" cy="65" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <circle cx="165" cy="65" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.05s;" />
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle cx="45" cy="105" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.15s;" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="105" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.25s;" />
      <circle cx="125" cy="105" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
      <circle cx="165" cy="105" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.3s;" />
      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle cx="45" cy="145" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.05s;" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="145" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <circle cx="125" cy="145" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.15s;" />
      <circle cx="165" cy="145" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.25s;" />
      <!-- Row 4 -->
      <circle cx="45" cy="185" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.2s;" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="185" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.05s;" />
      <circle cx="125" cy="185" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.3s;" />
      <circle cx="165" cy="185" r="14" class="p-solid" style="animation-delay: 0.1s;" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(295, 70)">
    <!-- Container Box -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="210" height="260" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3" />
    
    <!-- Label & Description -->
    <text x="105" y="300" class="sans label">Liquid</text>
    <text x="105" y="323" class="sans desc">Close, but random</text>
    <text x="105" y="343" class="sans desc">Move past each other</text>
    <text x="105" y="366" class="sans subdesc">(Flows to fill container)</text>

    <!-- Particles (Irregular, flowing) -->
    <g fill="#10b981" stroke="#047857" stroke-width="2">
      <circle cx="45" cy="85" r="14" class="p-liq-1" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="75" r="14" class="p-liq-2" />
      <circle cx="125" cy="85" r="14" class="p-liq-3" />
      <circle cx="165" cy="75" r="14" class="p-liq-1" />

      <circle cx="65" cy="120" r="14" class="p-liq-2" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="115" r="14" class="p-liq-3" />
      <circle cx="145" cy="125" r="14" class="p-liq-1" />

      <circle cx="45" cy="160" r="14" class="p-liq-3" />
      <circle cx="85" cy="155" r="14" class="p-liq-1" />
      <circle cx="125" cy="165" r="14" class="p-liq-2" />
      <circle cx="165" cy="155" r="14" class="p-liq-3" />

      <circle cx="65" cy="200" r="14" class="p-liq-1" />
      <circle cx="105" cy="195" r="14" class="p-liq-2" />
      <circle cx="145" cy="200" r="14" class="p-liq-3" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(550, 70)">
    <!-- Container Box -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="210" height="260" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3" />
    
    <!-- Label & Description -->
    <text x="105" y="300" class="sans label">Gas</text>
    <text x="105" y="323" class="sans desc">Far apart</text>
    <text x="105" y="343" class="sans desc">Move fast in all directions</text>
    <text x="105" y="366" class="sans subdesc">(Fills entire space)</text>

    <!-- Motion trails for gas -->
    <g stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3" fill="none" opacity="0.6">
      <path d="M 60 90 Q 90 60 120 110" />
      <path d="M 150 80 Q 110 130 80 160" />
      <path d="M 100 200 Q 140 180 160 120" />
      <path d="M 50 150 Q 80 190 120 210" />
    </g>

    <!-- Particles (Spread out, moving fast) -->
    <g fill="#f59e0b" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2">
      <circle cx="55" cy="75" r="14" class="p-gas-1" />
      <circle cx="155" cy="85" r="14" class="p-gas-2" />
      <circle cx="95" cy="140" r="14" class="p-gas-3" />
      <circle cx="145" cy="195" r="14" class="p-gas-4" />
      <circle cx="55" cy="210" r="14" class="p-gas-2" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Footer instruction -->
  <text x="400" y="470" class="sans subdesc" style="font-size: 14px; fill: #475569;">
    GCSE Chemistry: Compare how particle arrangement and movement change across the three states.
  </text>
</svg>
